t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The color of the gnome will impact your mushroom count. Use the 1x multiplier rounds to experiment which color yields the highest results. The color suggestions made by the prior participant may not be accurate for these rounds

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to which mushroom person gives you more mushrooms. There are four pairs:Pink and greenPurple and brownBlue and orangeRed and yellowIn one version of the game the choice will remain consistent. For example, purple gives better results than brown always. In another version of the game it appears the choice may be random or switch halfway through the round. For example, purple gives better results the first half of the round but brown gives better results the last half of the round.Use the 1x rounds to experiment which mushroom is giving better results. You want to avoid the mushroom with 0 returns.
